description: This file contains the implementation of a mutable, non-thread-safe connection logger class named DefaultMuteableConnectionLogger. It manages logging behavior (mute/unmute) for a specific connection, delegating actual log operations to an underlying delegate logger while controlling whether logs are emitted based on the mute state.

classes.name: DefaultMuteableConnectionLogger
classes.description: A non-thread-safe, mutable implementation of a connection logger that can be muted and unmuted, controlling whether logs are passed to the delegate.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Mutes the logger, preventing log messages from being forwarded to the delegate.

methods.name: unmute
methods.description: Unmutes the logger, allowing log messages to be forwarded to the delegate.

methods.name: isMuted
methods.description: Checks whether the logger is currently muted.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Logs a successful connection event if unmuted.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Logs a successful connection event with a custom message if unmuted.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Logs a failure event with an exception if unmuted.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Logs a failure event with a custom message if unmuted.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Logs an exception event if unmuted.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Logs an exception event with a custom message if unmuted.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the logs in the delegate.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Returns the logs if unmuted; otherwise, returns an empty collection.

methods.name: logTrace
methods.description: Internal method to log trace messages with enhanced connection info.

methods.name: logTraceWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Internal method to log trace messages with connection and correlation IDs.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality check based on connectionId, delegate, and active state.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on connectionId, delegate, and active state.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the logger, including connectionId, delegate, and mute status.
